tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gtsug tor lha mo rol ma bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ de bī ma hā ka li ha sa uṣ+ṇī ṣa nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ lha mo nag mo chen mo rol par byed pa'i gtsug tor zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dpal gshin rje gshed nag po la phyag 'tshal lo// gdon chen po 'bum phrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang nas/ gdon chen po rnams nyung ngu bsdus nas smos pa/ ro langs nag mo'i gdon dang*/ sha za nag mo'i gdon dang*/ skem byed nag mo'i gdon dang*/ sgrib byed nag mo'i gdon dang*/ phung byed nag mo'i gdon dang*/ drang srong nag mo'i gdon dang*/ srin mo nag mo'i gdon dang*/ rlung lha nag mo'i gdon dang*/ dbang ldan nag mo'i gdon dang*/ dpal ldan nag mo'i gdon dang*/ nam gru nag mo'i gdon dang*/ klu mo nag mo'i gdon dang*/ nam gru nag mo skyong byed ro langs ma'i gdon dang*// nam gru chen mo phung byed seng ge gdong gi gdon dang*/ nam gru chen mo mkha' la rgyu ba khyung gshog ma'i gdon dang*/ nam gru chen mo ral gcig ma nya ba pa'i gdon dang*/ nam gru chen mo so gcig ma'i gdon dang*/ bong zhon chen mo gur gcig ma'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po gnyis la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po gsum la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po bzhi la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po lnga la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po drug la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po bdun la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po brgyad la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po dgu la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po bcu la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po bcu gcig la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po bcu gnyis la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ gur chen po bcu gsum la dbang ba'i gdon dang*/ rims nad thams cad la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang*/ de dag kun gyi 'thab mo dang*/ 'khrug pa la dbang byed pa'i gdon dang*/ bdud kyi dmag dpung byed pa thams cad dang*/ nad dang rims la dbang byed pa chen po dang*/

kha nad dang*/ mgul nad dang*/ rgyu nad dang*/ snying nad dang*/ lkog ma na ba dang*/ lha gor na ba dang*/ brla na ba dang*/ rje ngar na ba dang*/ chu so na ba dang*/ shu ba dang*/ g.yan pa dang*/ 'brum bu phra mos na ba dang*/ brla na ba dang*/ me dbal dang*/ lhog pa dang*/ skem pa dang*/ dbyig dug dang*/ dug sbyar ma dang*/ rgyu gzer dang*/ pho lhang dang*/ gnyan pa dang*/ rgyu rims la sogs pa thams cad rig sngags kyis bcad do// phur bus gdab po/ rig sngags kyi mgon po rnams kyis dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ gnod sbyin ro langs legs ldan nag po grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa'i rig sngags kyis bcad do// phur bus gdab po/ gnod sbyin smyo byed rnga gzhon dang*// gon rgyun la sogs gdon rnams ni// smyo byed gdon du za ba dang*// shugs 'gro byams ma'i rig sngags bcad// mkha' 'gro byams ma'i phur bus gdab// hi sti hri ni hūṃ druṃ hūṃ/ hriṣ+ṭi kā li ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bud med nag mor mngon pa dang*// rnal 'byor spyan rtul byed pa ni// sgrib byed nag mo'i gdon yin te/ legs ldan dka' thub rig sngags bcad// dbang phyug gtso bos phur bus gdab// du ru se hūṃ druṃ/ pra ma kī la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ skya rims klad pa na ba dang*// rkang pa 'khol ba'i nad byung na// 'byung po nag po'i gdon yin pas// dpal chen dbang gi rig sngags bcad/ shugs 'gros byams ma'i phur bus gdab// sha shwa dha ra hūṃ druṃ/ mo dha ra ki la ya hūṃ bh+yaḥphaṭa/ lci zhing nad ni 'thibs pa dang*// gnyid che sems la mi dran pa// bud med nag mo'i gdon yin pas// rgyal bar byed pa'i rig sngags bcad// sbrang rtsir byed pa'i phur bus gdab// me la dha ra hūṃ druṃ// sra ma sra ma su ma kī la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bya dgu ye nas mi btub cing*// las su bsam pa mi 'grub na// drang srong gza' yi gdon yin pas// mi yi thod pa can gyi rig sngags bcad// dge sbyong gcer bu'i phur bus gdab// pa tra pa tra hūṃ dru/

sau mi kī la ya/ pa tra rag bh+yaḥphaṭa/ rnal 'byor spyan rtul byed pa dang*// sems ni yeng yeng seng seng po// ro stod mnan pa snyam byed pa/ srin po nag po'i gdon yin pas/ phyag na rdo rjes rigs sngags bcad// rdo rje khrag 'thung phur bus gdab// bh+raṃ mā dha na ya hūm̐ druṃdha ra sha ka ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ khro ba dang ni 'tshig pa dang*// smra 'dod smyon 'thabs 'thab mo rgod// rkang lag brkyang bskum bya smyang byed// dbang ldan nag mo'i gdon yin pas// dpal ldan gtso bo'i rig sngags bcad// mgon po nag po'i pur bus gdab// te tse ye nan hūṃ druṃ/ dza li kī la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ nam phyed gung la gnyid med dang*// cho 'phrul mang po 'byung ba dang*// bong bu phag pa'i gzugs bstan na/ nam gru nag po'i gdon yin pas/ rta mgrin dmar pos rig sngags bcad// khro bo stang stabs phur bus gdab// ya man ta kri ta hūṃ druṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra kro dha kī la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ rkang lag rengs shing na ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus shing skyug bro ba// gshin rje nag po'i gdon yin pas// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rig sngags bcad// mi pham yum gyis phur bus gdab// ya ma rā dza kro dha kī la ye hūṃ druṃ/ ya ma rā dzā kro dha ki la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ gzhogs skam pa dang rengs pa dang*// zha grum sha lus sngo la 'jam// mig nad can dang rkang pa na// mdze dang shu ba g.yan pa ni// klu mo spus 'gro'i gdon yin pas/ bya khyung he yis rig sngags bcad// drang srong rgan po'i phur bus gdab// ho nā ga leṃ dza ra tsa hūṃ druṃ/ hu yā hu yā kī la ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sems la yeng yeng seng seng byed// ro stod mnan pa snyam byed cing*// kha so na ba'i nad rnams ni// gnod sbyin nag po'i gdon yin pas// rnam thos sras kyis rig sngags bcad// bum sna dmar po'i phur bus gdab// he sa baṃ ma thi kha kha rag hūṃ druṃ/ kha rag ga da ra ta ki la ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/

shu ba 'brum bu na ba dang*// sha lus na 'am g.yan pa'i nad rnams ni// nam gru skyong khyed ro langs gdon yin pas// gshin rje thogs med rig sngags bcad// mgrin bzang dmar po'i phur bus gdab// de ma ma ti hūṃ dru/ pa tra kī lā ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/ 'jigs shing phya sangs khyer ba dang*// tho rangs phya 'phyo byed pa ni// nam gru he yi gdon yin pas// ya ma he yis rig sngags bcad// 'dod pa dmar pa'i phur bus gdab// ra du na tra bā da ru na hūṃ dru/ ko ma ri kī lā ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ phrag tu na dang lci ba dang*// mig la rab rib mi mthong ba// nam gru khyung gshog gdon yin pas// khro bo hūṃ gis rig sngags bcad// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i phur bus gdab// pra ri tra du na bh+yaḥphaṭa/ pra ma na ṇa kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ g.yas pa'i lag pa gzer ba dang*// dpung mgo g.yas su gzer ba'i nad// lag gcig nyab pa'i gdon yin pas// khro bo dbyings kyis rig sngags bcad// dbang phyug ma yis phur bus gdab// pra du na pra ro tra ya phaṭa/ pra ma kī lī ya hūṃ druṃ/ smyos shing khrag tu bshal ba dang*// mig sngar sna tshogs gzugs 'ong na// so gcig mig gcig gdon yin pas// de ni legs ldan nag po'i gdon yin pas// legs ldan phyir 'ong rig sngags bcad// dka' thub gtso bo'i phur bus gdab// rak+ṣa se hūṃ druṃ/ rak+ṣa mā kī lī ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ra kra lā kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dar dkar gur gyi nang shed nas// bud med mnga' bdag cho 'phrul che// gza' skar mi bzad sku 'byung ba// gser dang g.yus brgyan dbang mo che// kun tu bzang mo'i cho 'phrul te// dus ngan tha ma 'khrug pa dang*// ser ba than pa mu ge btsa'// chos kyi dbyings kyi rig sngags bcad// ting nge 'dzin gyi phur bus gdab// dharma da du bh+ya phaṭa/ sa ma yā ki ti yā kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ g.yu gur gnyis la dbang byed pa'i// mthing ga chen mo dbang mo che// ba lang dre'u la zhon pa dang*// nam phyed dgung la cho 'phrul ba// nam gru mthing ga'i gdon yin pas// dbang chen hūṃ gis rig sngags bcad// khyab pa dmar po'i phur bus gdab// sarba kan dhe bh+ya phaṭa/

da ruṃ kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ gur nag khyung rus brgyan pa dang*// nub nas shar du gnod pa dang*// mgul nad snying nad gtong ba ni// 'og gi nag mo'i cho 'phrul te// seng gdong drag po'i rig sngags bcad// dka' thub gtso bo'i phur bus gdab// nā ga le rā dzā hūṃ druṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ yā hūṃ yā kī la ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/ gser gur khra bo'i gur phub nas/ mu men gur gyi nang shes na// gzugs med lag pa ston pa dang*// gnyid kyis 'thibs pa'i nad byung ba// kha nas khrag tu skyug pa dang*// lus la tshad pa skyes pa dang*// mig sngar rlung dang mun sros na// lha mo nag mo'i gdon yin pas// dh+ri ta dkar pa'i rig sngags bcad// byad tri dmar po'i phur bus gdab// sa ma ya de ma daṃ bh+ya phaṭa/ ma ma sa ma yā tsa hi kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ re lde gur gyi nang shad na// bud med gnam sa sleb pa dang*// tshubs ma'i gzugs su ston pa dang*// kha nas glo khrag 'ong ba dang*// ngar snabs rnag tu 'ong ba dang*// gri thogs bshan pa'i las byed na// bdud kyi bshan pa'i gdon yin pas// khyung gi khrag thogs rig sngags bcad// dug chen tshang 'dor phur bus gdab// ha hūṃ ru tri ki la ye hūṃ dru/ gser gyi gur la dbang byed pa// ltag pa rgyab dang lha gor dang*// lto nad skrangs 'bur nad byung na// bya gdong gser gdab gdon yin pas// 'jam dpal ro thung rig sngags bcad// mi pham dbyings kyis phur bus gdab// sa mā yā ma de hūṃ da ra hūṃ bh+ya phaṭa/ dha ra hūṃ druṃ/ glang chen ko rlon gur nang nas// bong ku zhon pa'i bud med dang*// gdung ba'i nga ro sgrog pa dang*// lhog pa glo dang sha ser dang*// skrangs pa la sogs dal gyi nad// srid pa 'jug byed gdon yin pas// gshin rje hrīṣ+ṭī'i rig sngags bcad// 'bar ma dpal gyi phur bus gdab// ma ma ṇan bh+ya phaṭa/ ma la dzā tu ra ki la ya hūṃ druṃ/

gser gur khra bo'i nang shed nas// snga rims dmag gi 'brang sdud ma// phyi rim dmag gi g.yul bzlog cing*// dkyus pa'i 'brog la phung bar byed// phung byed khang pa gtib pa dang*// sbos dang glang thabs na ba dang*// stod gzer snying gsha'i nad byung na// srid pa spyi lugs gdon yin pas// rig 'dzin rgyal po'i rig sngags bcad// 'khor ba rab 'joms phur bus gdab// ma mā nan bh+ya phaṭa/ pra ma nan kī lā ya hūṃ druṃ/ sa dgu gnam gyi steng shed na// mdze dang shu ba g.yan pa dang*// dug sbyor ba dang 'khrug pa dang*// gri ru gsod par byed pa ni// klu bdud phung byed gdon yin pas// rnam thos sras kyis rig sngags bcad// mgon po nag po'i phur bus gdab// rā dzā da ra kha ra ka bh+ya phaṭa/ ma hūṃ kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ bcu pa gnam gyi steng shed na// sgra gcan 'dzin gyi sring mo ni/ phya bdud nag mo'i bu mo ste// char pa 'ong du mi ster ba// ser ba chen po 'byung ba dang*// srid pa kun gyi cho 'phrul ba/ phya bdud gza' yi gdon yin te// dpal ldan dbyings kyis rig sngags bcad// mdzes ma sa 'dzin phur bus gdab// pra ma dzā ta ya bh+ya phaṭa/ pra tra kī la ye bh+ya hūṃ druṃ/ bcu gcig gnam gyi yar steng na// 'od kyi gur phub srid pa gsal// srid pa ri rab sku mkhar la// dpag bsam shing gi mchog phur btab// bcu gnyis bcu bzhi khyon du rdzogs// legs nyes kun gyi stangs 'dzin can// dam tshig kun gyi rtsad gcod ma// mu khe le ni dbyings ma'i mchog /'gro ba kun la sman pa'i phyir// bdud rtsi bcud kyi nang du bzhugs// zhal nas 'byung ba lnga 'char ba// 'gro ba kun la gsal gyur cig /zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sems can gang zhig smyo 'bog byed// smyo byed gdon du za ba'i dbang*// bgyis nas bla col mang po smra ba ni// ki kang gza' yi gdon yin pas// shugs 'gro byams pa'i rig sngags bcad// mkha' 'gro byams ma'i phur bus gdab// de bā tad tra badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ druṃ/

'di lan gsum bzlas na smyo byed gyi gdon rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro// sgrib byed gdon du za dbang gis// bud med nag mo bong zhon zhing*// rnal 'byor spyan ni rtul byed na// legs ldan dka' thub rig sngags bcad// dka' thub gtso bo phur bus gdab// lan gsum bzlas na rnal 'byor pa// spyan ni mthong ba dag tu 'gyur// da ru ye hūṃ dru/ pra ma ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ skya rims 'dis ni klad pa na// rkang pa khol ba'i rims rnams la// dpal chen dbang gis rig sngags bcad// shugs 'gro byams ma'i phur bus gdab// btab na de dag zhi 'gyur ro// sha shā da ra hūṃ druṃ/ me la da ra kī la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bud med nag mo'i gdon dbang gis// lci ba dang ni 'thib pa dang*// mi dran pa dang gnyid bro ba// rgyal bar byed pa'i rig sngags bcad// sbrang rtsir byed pa'i phur bus gdab// bud med gdon ni zhi 'gyur ro// mi dha ra hūṃ druṃ/ sruṃ sruṃ bh+ya kī lā ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/ mi phyugs god ka che ba dang*// ci yang bya ru mi btub pa// rtag tu lo phyugs nyes na yang*// gza' ngan pa la skyes pa yin// gzungs kyi snying po 'di dag ni// byang bu sor gsum la bris te// sgo yi ru bzhi la gzugs btsugs na de dag zhi 'gyur ro// pra trā pra trā rak+ṣa bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sau me kī lā ya hūṃ druṃ/ mi'i thod pa can dang dge sbyong gcer bu pa rnams kyis bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// gal te srin po'i gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ mig rtul zhing yeng yeng seng seng byed na/ snyam mi byed pa'i gdon rnams ni srin mo nag mo sha za ba'i gdon yin pas/ sha dha ra bh+yaḥphaṭa/ pra ma da ra hūṃ druṃ/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje khrag 'thung chen po noms kyis bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// dbang ldan gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ khro ba dang ni 'tshig pa dang*// smra 'dod 'thab mo rko ba dang*// rkang lag brkyang bskum mang po byed// de ba tsa ta ye nan hūṃ druṃ/

tsa pe da ra kī lā ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ dpal ldan gtso bo dang rig sngags kyi mgon po rnams kyis bsrung du gsol/ srung du gsol lo// nam gru gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ nam phyed dang ni nyin gung la// cho 'phrul mang po 'byung ba dang*// bong bu phag pa'i gzugs ston na// ya mān ta kri ta kro dha hūṃ druṃ/ badz+ra kro dha kī la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ rta mgrin dmar po dang*/ khro bo'i stang stabs kyis bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// gshin rje gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ rkang lag rengs shing yi ga 'chus// skyug bro ba yi nad rnams la// ya ma rā dzā hūṃ druṃ/ ya ma rā dzā kro dha kī la ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rig sngags dang*// mi pham ma yis phur bus bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// klu mo spus 'go ma'i gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ mig na ba dang rkang pa na// mdze dang shu ba g.yan pa la// nā ga la rā dzā hūṃ druṃ/ hu ya hu yā hūṃ druṃ ki li kī la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bya khyung he dang drang srong rgod pas bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// gnod sbyin nag po gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ sems ni yeng yeng seng seng byed// ro stod mnan pa snyam byed cing*// kha so na ba'i nad rnams la// he ma ma hri ti ga ra hūṃ dru/ kha tra ma kī la ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/ rnam thos sras kyi rig sngags dang*// bum sna dmar pos bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// na ma gru skyong byed gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ shu ba 'brum bu na ba dang*// sha lus na 'am g.yan pa'i nad rnams la// he ma ma ti hūṃ druṃ/ pra ti kī la ya hūṃ bh+yaḥphaṭa/ gshin rje thogs med rig sngags dang*// mgrin bzang dmar pos bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo/ nam gru ho gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ 'jigs shing phya sangs byed pa dang*// tho rang ca co byed pa'i gdon// ra hu na tri hūṃ druṃ/

kau ro ma kī la bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ya ma he dang 'dod pa dmar pos bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// lag gcig nyab pa'i gdon du za ba'i dbang gis// g.yas kyi phyogs su gzer ba dang*// g.yon gyi phyogs su 'brang ba dang*// dpung mgo lhung lhung byed pa ni// ra tu na pra mā ni ra so bh+yaḥphaṭa/ pra ma nan kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ khro bo dbyings dang dbang phyug mas bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// so gcig gdon du za ba'i dbang gis// myos shing khrag tu bshal ba dang*// mig sngar sna tshogs gzugs ston na// rak+ṣa sa hūṃ druṃ/ kha rag ma ki la ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ legs ldan phyir zlog dang dka' thub gtso bo rnams kyis bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// dar dkar gur phub nang shed na// bud med nag mo'i cho 'phrul ni// dus ngan dang ni than pa dang*// 'khrug pa dang ni 'thab pa dang*// btsa' dang ser ba 'byung ba ni// dhārma dha tu bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sa ma yā kī la ya hūm̐ druṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rig sngags dang*// ting nge 'dzin gyi phur bus bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// nam gru mthing nag gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ ba lang dre'u zhon pa la// nam phyed nyin dgung cho 'phrul ni// dha ru hūṃ druṃ/ sarba kan te kī la ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/ dpal chen dbang phyug rig sngags dang*// khyab pa dmar pos bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo/ 'og gi nag mo'i gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ mgul nad dang ni snying nad ni// klu bdud nag po'i gdon yin pas// nā ga ni hūṃ druṃ bh+yaḥphaṭa/ hu ma tsa tu ya kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ seng gdong drag po'i rig sngags dang*// dka' thub gtso bos bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// lha mo nag mo'i gdon du za ba'i dbang gis// gzugs med lag pa ston pa dang*// gnyid kyis 'thibs shing nad byung ba// kha nas khrag tu skyug pa dang*// lus la tshad pa skyes pa dang*// mig sngar rlung dang mun sros na// ya ma te hūṃ bh+yaḥphaṭa/

ma mā sa mā yā tsa he kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ hri sti ma tri dkar po dang bya tri dmar mo'i tshogs kyis srung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// gri thogs pa bshan pa gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ gang zhig rkyen zin mig snga ru// bud med gnam sa sleb pa dang*// tshubs ma'i gzugs su ston pa dang*// kha nas khrag tu skyugs pa dang*// ngar snabs rnag tu 'ong ba la// ha he ra hūm̐ ṇā tri bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ra hūm̐ ru tri kī la ya hūm̐ druṃ/ khyung gi khra thogs rig sngags dang dug chen tshang 'dor rnams kyis bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// byang gi gser thang gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ lhog pas rgyab dang lto nad dang*// lha gor skrangs 'bur nad byung na// gnod sbyin gdon gyis brlag 'gyur na// ya man a ma ta na da ra hūm̐ bh+yaḥphaṭa/ da ra da ra hūm̐ druṃ/ 'jam dpal ro thun rig sngags dang*// mi pham mdzes pa'i phur bus bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// srid pa 'jug byed gdon du za ba'i dbang gis// lhog pa glo dang sha ser dang*// srid pa la sogs dal byung na// ba lang dre'u zhon pa dang*// gdung ba'i nga ro sgra sgrog pa// ma ma nan bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ma mā dza dur kī la ya hūm̐ druṃ/ gshin rje hring gi rig sngags dang*// 'bar ma dpal gyi phur bus bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// srid pa spyi lugs gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ phung byed khang pa btib pa dang*// sbos dang glang thabs na ba dang*// stod gzer snying gcu'i nad byung na// pra na ma nan bh+yaḥphaṭa/ pra ma nan kī la ya hūṃ druṃ/ rig 'dzin rgyal po'i rig sngags dang*// 'khor ba rab 'joms phur bus bsrung du gsol lo// klu bdud phung byed gdon du za ba'i dbang gis/ mdze dang shu ba g.yan pa dang*// dug sbyor ba dang 'khrug pa dang*// gri ru gsod par byed pa yin// klu bdud phung byed gdon yin pas// rā dzā bya kha rak+ṣa bh+ya phaṭa/

ma mā hūṃ ya hūṃ druṃ/ rnam thos sras kyi rig sngags dang*// mgon po nag po'i phur bus bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo/ phya bdud gza' yi gdon dbang gis// char chu dus su mi 'bebs dang*// than pa btsa' dang mu ge dang*// ser ba chen po 'byung ba ni// drang srong gza' yi gdon yin pas// pra mā pa tra ya bh+yaḥphaṭa/ phaṭa ki la ya hūṃ druṃ/ dpal ldan dbyings kyi rig sngags dang*/ mdzes pa sa 'dzin phur bus bsrung du gsol// bsrung du gsol lo// de kun yongs kyi gtso mo ni// mu kha le ni dbyings ma'i mchog /srid pa kun gyi yu gcig ma// sems can kun la sman pa mdzad/ sems can kun la phan 'gyur mdzod// na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta swā hā// thams cad de bzhin gshegs par gyur cig swā hā/ lha mo nag mo'i gtsug tor 'di bklags pa tsam gyis rims dang*/ sri'u mi gsos pa dang*/ god ka byung ba dang*/ yas kyi bdud babs pa dang*/ 'khrug pa chen po byung ba dang*/ nad rims thams cad dang*/ gdon rims thams cad dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa dang*/ btsan gyi 'gyu srang la thebs pa dang*/ gnyan po'i rims su byung ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang du 'dre chen po zhugs pa dang*/ mi nag gi rtog pa smyo 'dres zin pa dang*/ mi bde ba thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /dpal gshin rje gshed kyi dpal zla gsang nag po las// dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo rol par byed pa'i gtsug tor zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// maṅga laṃ/// /gtsug tor dkar mo'i zlog sgyur bzhugs so/// /gtsug tor dkar mo'i zlog sgyur 'di la gtor chen gcig bshams la/ de la jo mo sku mdog dkar mo khro gnyer can/ phyag na mtshon cha dang gdugs dkar thogs pa btsugs te/ lha mo dngos su bsams la/ rang yang sgrol mar sgom/ gtor chung gcig gam nyer gcig bshams la/ de la oṃ āḥhūṃ dang sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/

de nas 'di skad du/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// bcom ldan 'das shāka thub sku yi sras// dgra gegs zlog pa'i mthu mo che// gdugs dkar lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ de bzhin rigs kyi gdugs dkar mo// lha gdon zlog phyir gshegs su gsol// rdo rje rigs kyi gdugs dkar mo// klu gdon zlog phyir gshegs su gsol// rin chen rigs kyi gdugs dkar mo// dbang gdon zlog phyir gshegs su gsol// pad+ma rigs kyi gdugs dkar mo// rgyal gdon zlog phyir gshegs su gsol// las kyi rigs kyi gdugs dkar mo// bod gtong zlog phyir gshegs su gsol// e h+ya hi/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa tra pa si/ ma hā ku ru ṇi/ sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥ jo mo gdugs dkar lha tshogs la// me tog dam pa yid 'ong dam pa dang*// bdug spos dam pa na 'bun bzhin du 'thul// snang gsal dam pa 'od 'bar lhabs se lhabs// dri chab dam pa yi rang sangs se sangs// zhal zas dam pa ro brgya dam pa dang*// rol mo sil snyan rgyun du mi 'chad pa// 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs rjes bzhes su gsol// badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta pu dza me ga sa mud tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bcom ldan dregs rtsal thogs pa med/ bdud 'dul lha tshogs kun gyi gtso// 'jigs mdzad ma mo bzhad pa'i zhal// dgra dpung zlog pa'i mthu mo che// gzhan gyis mi thub la sogs pa'i// lha mo nyer gcig gshegs su gsol// dgra gegs zlog phyir gshegs su gsol// jo mo gdugs dkar lha tshogs la// mdzes pa'i ba ling rgyan gyis brgyan// ba ling mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// byin gyis rlob la bar chad sel// jo mo gtsug tor gdugs dkar can// mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan gyis brgyan// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro// sku chen rdzogs pas sa gsum non// jo mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bh+yoḥ

gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che// lha yi gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// gtum pa chen po stobs chen mo// klu yi gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// 'bar ba chen mo stobs chen mo// lha min gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo// rlung lha'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// 'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo// mkha' lding gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// 'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can// dri za'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags// mi 'am gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// pad+ma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan// lto 'phye'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can// gnod sbyin gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// rdo rje mkha' bsnams 'joms pa mo/ srin po'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod ma// yi dwags gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// gzugs zhi gzi brjid chen mo can// sha za'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo// 'byung po'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang*// grul bum gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin ma// srul po'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// lag na rdo rje rigs gser phreng*// lus srul gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma// skem byed gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags// brjed byed gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// rnam par 'gyings ma rdo rje dang*// smyo byed gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma// grib gnon gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol/ rdo rje 'gros dang dkar mo dang*// gnon pa'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang*// nam gru'i gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol// tad+ya thā/

oṃ a na le/ a na le/ bi shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ bhai re bhai re/ sau me sau me/ badz+ra dha ra ṇi/ ban dha ban dha/ badz+ra pā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ druṃ ban+dha phaṭa/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /gegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlog /glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog /rbad 'dre rbod gtong phur kha zlog /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /za kha sri khar zhugs pa zlog /za 'dre phung 'dre langs pa zlog /mi mthun mi gshis pa thams cad zlog /hūm̐ bh+yo/ zas su mngal za khrag 'thung ba// zas su sha tshil za la sogs// rang rang ba ling 'di bzhes la// bzung ba thong la bcings pa phrol/ phyin chad 'khor 'dir gnod ma byed// hūm̐ bh+yo/ srid pa'i lha 'dre gnyan po kun// glud dang gtor ma 'di long la// bzhud cig bzhud cig da bzhud cig /gshegs shig gshegs shig da gshegs shig /song zhig song zhig da song zhig /mi dang gdon gnyis phye la song*// gal te mi 'gro mi nyan na// gdugs dkar lha tshogs thugs khros nas// mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru 'gas// lus ni dum bu stong du 'gro// de bas rang rang gnas su dengs// 'di yi bka' las ma 'da' shig /gal te bka' las 'das pa na// ma mo yongs kyis khrag zor rgyob// chos skyong mgon pos mda' zar rgyob// dpal ldan lha mos sgong zor rgyob// phyogs skyong bcu yis hom zor rgyob// rgyal chen bzhi yis rdo zor rgyob/ ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog /mas kyi sri ni langs pa zlog /rbad 'dre rbod gtong thams cad zlog /pha mes byur 'dre langs pa zlog /yul na yul chags che ba zlog /grong na grong chags che ba zlog /sgo na sgo chags che ba zlog /khyim na khyim chags che ba zlog /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /mo ngan ltas ngan thams cad zlog

/srin bya phyung phyung zer ba zlog /'ug pa ha ha zer ba zlog /dur sar wa mo brgyal ba zlog /dur khrod spyang khu ngu ba zlog /phu ru sha ba'i ru 'dzings zlog /mda' yi nya mo gshog 'dzings zlog /bar gyi pho rog sder 'dzings zlog /grong gi nag mo bya 'dzings zlog /srod la bya pho 'tsher ba zlog /nam phyed rta pho 'tsher ba zlog /tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba zlog /lo skag zla skag thams cad zlog /pho brgya mda' ltar gsor ba zlog /mo brgya bal ltar g.yeng ba zlog /hūṃ bh+yo/ za byed nyi shu rtsa gcig zlog /lha yi gdon la sogs pa yi// gdon rigs nyi shu rtsa gcig zlog /gnod byed gdon chen bco lnga zlog /gdon chen phal pa bcu bzhi zlog /gnod byed lha srin sde brgyad zlog /gegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /bdag la gnod byed thams cad zlog /byams pa gnyen gyis bgyis pa zlog /rgyal khams mi yis gleng ba zlog /mi kha bram mchu za ba zlog /sdang dgra gnod byed thams cad zlog /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zlog /legs na mi dga' nyes na dga' ba thams cad zlog /rig sngags kyis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// ces gong bzhin brjod rjes la bkra shis brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam bya/ 'di la gang dgos gzhung bzhin shes te/ rlung rta rgud pa dang*/ nad rims 'bar ba dang*/ kha smras thug pa dang*/ grong pa'i byol po dang*/ 'dre ldang ba dang*/ de la sogs pa gang dgos par byas la/ nyams su blang bar bya'o// tshig don yid la bsams shing snying nas brjod do// gtsug tor dkar mo'i zlog sgyur rdzogs so/// /maṅga laṃ// dge'o/// /
